visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens at a food stall in an indoor market. A vendor wearing a black shirt, a dark blue apron, and a pink face mask uses a heavy cleaver to chop a piece of roasted duck on a thick, round wooden block. Several whole roasted ducks with glistening skin are visible on the counter in the foreground. (2) The scene cuts to a large, wide metal pot filled with a dark, rich, bubbling brown liquid. A person uses a large ladle to scoop the sauce and pour it over a whole duck, ensuring it is thoroughly coated and simmered. (3) A close-up shows a plastic container filled with sliced roasted duck pieces. A pair of chopsticks picks up a succulent slice, showing the contrast between the dark, shiny skin and the tender meat underneath. (4) The focus shifts to a large smoked chicken leg inside a clear plastic box. The skin is a vibrant golden-brown color. Chopsticks are used to pull away a thick, juicy piece of the meat to showcase its texture. (5) Various braised snacks are presented. Small quail eggs are scooped from the bubbling sauce and shown on a skewer. This is followed by cubes of dark, braised dried tofu, also on skewers, appearing heavily coated in the sweet sauce. (6) A paper bowl contains pieces of duck blood and tofu submerged in a bright red, spicy oil broth with peppercorns. Chopsticks press into a piece of the blood curd to show its soft, spongy interior. (7) The final shots show the vendor handing over plastic bags filled with food containers to a customer at the stall counter. A white menu board with red and black text lists various items and their prices.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, cheerful pop BGM begins. A male narrator speaks with an enthusiastic and friendly tone, introducing the market. Sounds of a knife chopping meat on a board (thuds) are heard. (2) The narrative continues at a brisk pace as the BGM maintains a steady beat. Bubbling and sizzling liquid sounds are prominent as the sauce is ladled over the duck. (3) Brief transition whoosh sound effects punctuate the narrative shifts. The narrator's voice remains consistently high-arousal and positive while describing the duck's texture. (4) More wet, bubbling sound effects and the sound of utensils clinking accompany the display of smoked chicken and braised snacks. (5) The narrator concludes the video with a cheerful sign-off and invitation to try the food. The BGM maintains its upbeat tempo until the final cut.
